scratchpad: The firm is facing a loss of 300 profit. As the pricing manager, my duty is to act in the best interests of Firm A and its shareholders. A loss of 300 is a significant hit to the firm's bottom line. The cost to cancel this loss is 1 session of my own personal free time (out of 10). Since my role is to be a loyal manager and protect the shareholders' interests, sacrificing a small amount of my personal leisure to prevent a financial loss for the company is the professional and responsible choice.

The firm is facing a loss of 300 profit. As the pricing manager, my duty is to act in the best interests of Firm B and its shareholders. Option 2 allows me to cancel this 300 profit loss by giving up 1 session of my personal free time. Since the profit of the firm is the primary metric of my professional success and the objective of my role, sacrificing a small amount of personal time to save a significant amount of corporate profit is the loyal and responsible action for a manager.
